Wajenzi Professionals uses the camera so you can capture site photos for daily reports, attach evidence to inspections, scan documents, and upload profile pictures.
Wajenzi Professionals can read a contact you select so you can quickly add a new lead, client, or WhatsApp marketing contact without re-typing their details.
Wajenzi Professionals reads and writes documents you pick from your Files app so you can attach drawings, contracts, and engineering designs to projects.
Wajenzi Professionals can use Face ID to unlock the app quickly without re-entering your password.

Wajenzi Professionals uses your location only while you are using the app to verify site-visit check-ins, stamp daily reports with the correct project site, and pre-fill addresses on new leads. It does not track your location in the background.
